q23042.en: In the situation shown in the picture, the tram has priority over the other vehicles.

explain.short: Vehicles on rails, like the tram, usually have priority over other vehicles at a junction.
explain.rule: The tram goes first. With no signs, give way to the right; a car turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. Here A moves to the centre, then O, M and finally A.
explain.trap: 'il tram ha la precedenza' (the tram has priority) is correct here: no sign or officer says otherwise.

sceneParams.caption: The tram goes first

q23043.en: At the junction shown in the picture, all vehicles must be careful when crossing it.

explain.short: Prudence is always required at a junction, for every driver, even the one with priority.
explain.rule: The tram goes first. With no signs, give way to the right; a car turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. Here A moves to the centre, then O, M and finally A.
explain.trap: 'tutti i veicoli' (all vehicles) is right: having priority never means you can stop being careful.

sceneParams.caption: Everyone crosses with care

q23044.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle O must wait for the tram to pass and for vehicle A to move to the centre.

explain.short: After the tram, A, O and M block each other in a circle. A breaks the circle by moving to the centre; then O can go.
explain.rule: The tram goes first. With no signs, give way to the right; a car turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. Here A moves to the centre, then O, M and finally A.
explain.trap: 'si porti al centro' (moves to the centre) is the key: A only advances to the middle, it does not finish its turn yet.

sceneParams.caption: Tram, A to the centre, then O goes

keywords.en: wait for the tram to pass

q23045.en: In the situation shown in the picture, the tram goes through first.

explain.short: The tram runs on rails and has priority over the other vehicles, so it crosses first.
explain.rule: The tram goes first. With no signs, give way to the right; a car turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. Here A moves to the centre, then O, M and finally A.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is right for the tram: no sign or officer takes its priority away.

sceneParams.caption: The tram crosses first

q23046.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle M must wait for vehicle O to pass.

explain.short: M comes from the right side of the picture and O comes from M's right. M must give way to O.
explain.rule: The tram goes first. With no signs, give way to the right; a car turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. Here A moves to the centre, then O, M and finally A.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait) is correct: O is on M's right.

sceneParams.caption: O is on M's right: M waits

q23047.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle M crosses the junction together with the tram.

explain.short: M cannot go with the tram: after the tram, M must still wait for O, who comes from M's right.
explain.rule: The tram goes first. With no signs, give way to the right; a car turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. Here A moves to the centre, then O, M and finally A.
explain.trap: 'insieme al tram' (together with the tram) is the trap: M goes later, after O.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: M goes after the tram AND after O

q23048.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle A, when turning left, has a free right side.

explain.short: While A turns left it ends up facing north, and then M comes from its right. So A's right is not free: it must let M pass.
explain.rule: The tram goes first. With no signs, give way to the right; a car turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. Here A moves to the centre, then O, M and finally A.
explain.trap: 'ha la destra libera' (has its right free) is the trap: during the turn, M arrives from A's right.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: during the turn M is on A's right

q23048.reviewNote: Official FALSE for "A ha la destra libera": the road on A's right is empty when it arrives; FALSE only holds mid-turn, when motorbike M comes from A's right. Check the textbook reasoning.

q23049.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle O must wait for the tram and vehicle M to pass.

explain.short: O waits only for the tram (and for A to move to the centre). M is on O's left, so M waits for O, not the opposite.
explain.rule: The tram goes first. With no signs, give way to the right; a car turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. Here A moves to the centre, then O, M and finally A.
explain.trap: 'ed il veicolo M' (and vehicle M) is the trap: O does not give way to M.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: M waits for O, not O for M

q23050.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle O must wait for all the other vehicles to pass.

explain.short: O is not last: it goes right after the tram (once A is in the centre), before M and before A finishes its turn.
explain.rule: The tram goes first. With no signs, give way to the right; a car turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. Here A moves to the centre, then O, M and finally A.
explain.trap: 'tutti gli altri veicoli' (all the other vehicles) is the trap: O waits only for the tram.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: O goes second, not last

q23051.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle A must give way to the tram, but not to vehicle M.

explain.short: A turns left, so it must also let the oncoming motorbike M pass (going straight), not only the tram.
explain.rule: The tram goes first. With no signs, give way to the right; a car turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. Here A moves to the centre, then O, M and finally A.
explain.trap: 'ma non al veicolo M' (but not to vehicle M) is the trap: A gives way to M too.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: A gives way to the tram AND to M

q23052.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle O must give way to the tram and to vehicle M.

explain.short: O gives way to the tram only. M is on O's left, so M must give way to O.
explain.rule: The tram goes first. With no signs, give way to the right; a car turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. Here A moves to the centre, then O, M and finally A.
explain.trap: 'ed al veicolo M' (and to vehicle M) is the trap: O has priority over M.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: O gives way to the tram, not to M

q23053.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle B does not have to give way to the other two vehicles.

explain.short: Bus B has no road on its right, so nobody comes from its right: it gives way to no one.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. B has nobody on its right: B, then H, then C.
explain.trap: 'non deve dare la precedenza' (does not have to give way) is correct for B.

sceneParams.caption: B has a free right: it goes first

keywords.en: does not have to give way

q23054.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle H goes second.

explain.short: B goes first (nobody on its right). H has B on its right, so it goes right after B; C waits for H.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. B has nobody on its right: B, then H, then C.
explain.trap: 'per secondo' (second) is correct: H waits only for B.

sceneParams.caption: Order: B, H, C

q23055.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle C must clear the junction last.

explain.short: C has bus H on its right, and H waits for B. So C goes after both.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. B has nobody on its right: B, then H, then C.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is correct for C.

sceneParams.caption: Order: B, H, C

q23056.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle B goes first.

explain.short: B has no road and no vehicle on its right, so it gives way to nobody and goes first.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. B has nobody on its right: B, then H, then C.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is correct for B.

sceneParams.caption: B goes first

q23057.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle C must give way to vehicle H.

explain.short: H comes from the road on C's right, so C must let H pass.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. B has nobody on its right: B, then H, then C.
explain.trap: 'deve dare la precedenza al veicolo H' is correct: H is on C's right.

sceneParams.caption: H is on C's right: C gives way

q23058.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle H goes first.

explain.short: H has bus B on its right, so it must wait for B. H goes second.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. B has nobody on its right: B, then H, then C.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is the trap: H is second, after B.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: H goes second, after B

q23059.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicles B and C go first and at the same time.

explain.short: B goes first, but C cannot go with it: C must wait for H, who is on its right.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. B has nobody on its right: B, then H, then C.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is the trap: C goes last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: B first, C last

q23060.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle H must enter the junction after vehicles B and C have passed.

explain.short: H waits only for B. C is on H's left and must wait for H.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. B has nobody on its right: B, then H, then C.
explain.trap: 'dopo il passaggio dei veicoli B e C' (after B and C) is the trap: H goes before C.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: H goes after B but before C

keywords.it: dopo il passaggio dei veicoli B e C
keywords.en: after B and C have passed

q23061.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle H has priority over vehicle C because it is a bus.

explain.short: H does go before C, but because it comes from C's right, not because it is a bus. A bus has no special priority.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. B has nobody on its right: B, then H, then C.
explain.trap: 'in quanto è un autobus' (because it is a bus) is the trap: the reason is wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong reason: H is on C's right

q23062.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle C goes first.

explain.short: C has bus H on its right, and H waits for B. So C goes last, not first.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. B has nobody on its right: B, then H, then C.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is the trap: C is last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: C goes last

q23063.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle R goes first.

explain.short: R has no vehicle coming from its right, so it gives way to nobody and goes first.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is correct for R.

sceneParams.caption: Order: R, A, C

q23064.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle C must go last.

explain.short: C has A on its right, and A has R on its right. So C waits for both and goes last.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is correct for C.

sceneParams.caption: Order: R, A, C

q23065.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle A must go after vehicle R.

explain.short: R comes from A's right, so A must let R pass first.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'dopo il veicolo R' (after R) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: R is on A's right: A waits

q23066.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle A goes before vehicle C.

explain.short: A comes from C's right, so C must wait for A. A goes second, C last.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'prima del veicolo C' (before C) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: A is on C's right: A first

q23067.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle C must go after vehicles R and A.

explain.short: C waits for A (on its right), and A waits for R. So C goes after both.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'dopo i veicoli R e A' (after R and A) is correct: C is last.

sceneParams.caption: Order: R, A, C

keywords.it: dopo i veicoli R e A

q23068.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle A, if it is a police car with its warning devices on, goes first.

explain.short: A police car on an emergency (siren and blue flashing light on) has priority over everyone, so A would go first.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'con i dispositivi di allarme in funzione' (with siren and blue light on) is the key: only then does A go first.

sceneParams.caption: Police with siren: A goes first

q23069.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle A goes first.

explain.short: R comes from A's right, so A must wait for R. A goes second.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is the trap: A is second, after R.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: A goes second, after R

q23070.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle A must go last.

explain.short: A comes from C's right, so C waits for A. A goes second; C is last.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is the trap: C is last, not A.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: A goes second, C last

q23071.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle R must go after vehicle A.

explain.short: It is the opposite: R is on A's right, so A waits for R.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'dopo il veicolo A' (after A) is the trap: R goes before A.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: R goes before A

q23072.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle R must cross the junction second.

explain.short: R has nobody on its right, so it goes first, not second.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'per secondo' (second) is the trap: R is first.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: R goes first

q23073.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle C goes second.

explain.short: C has A on its right, and A waits for R. So C is third, not second.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'per secondo' (second) is the trap: A is second, C is last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: C goes last

q23074.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicles C and R go first and at the same time.

explain.short: R goes first, but C cannot go with it: C must wait for A, who is on its right.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is the trap: C goes last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: R first, C last

q23075.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle L crosses the junction first.

explain.short: L goes straight and has nobody on its right. C and H must give way to it.
explain.rule: No signs here: give way to the right, and a car turning left lets oncoming straight traffic pass. Order: L, then C, then H.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is correct for L.

sceneParams.caption: Order: L, C, H

q23076.en: In the situation shown in the picture, vehicle H crosses the junction last.

explain.short: H turns left: it has C on its right and L coming straight from the opposite side. So H waits for both.
explain.rule: No signs here: give way to the right, and a car turning left lets oncoming straight traffic pass. Order: L, then C, then H.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is correct for H.

sceneParams.caption: Order: L, C, H

q23077.en: You may cross the junction in the picture in this order: vehicle L, vehicle C, vehicle H.

explain.short: L has nobody on its right; C has L on its right; H has C on its right. So L, C, H.
explain.rule: No signs here: give way to the right, and a car turning left lets oncoming straight traffic pass. Order: L, then C, then H.
explain.trap: 'veicolo L, veicolo C, veicolo H' is exactly the correct order.

sceneParams.caption: Order: L, C, H

keywords.it: veicolo L, veicolo C, veicolo H
keywords.en: vehicle L, vehicle C, vehicle H

q23078.en: You may cross the junction in the picture in this order: vehicle C after vehicle L, but before vehicle H.

explain.short: C waits for L (on its right), and H waits for C (on its right). So C is in the middle.
explain.rule: No signs here: give way to the right, and a car turning left lets oncoming straight traffic pass. Order: L, then C, then H.
explain.trap: 'dopo il veicolo L, ma prima del veicolo H' is correct: C is second.

sceneParams.caption: Order: L, C, H

q23079.en: You may cross the junction in the picture in this order: vehicle L at the same time as vehicle C, then vehicle H.

explain.short: C turns left and has L on its right. Both end up in the same road, so C must wait for L.
explain.rule: No signs here: give way to the right, and a car turning left lets oncoming straight traffic pass. Order: L, then C, then H.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is the trap: C goes after L.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: C goes after L

q23080.en: You may cross the junction in the picture in this order: vehicle H, vehicle C, vehicle L.

explain.short: This is the order backwards. L goes first and H, turning left, goes last.
explain.rule: No signs here: give way to the right, and a car turning left lets oncoming straight traffic pass. Order: L, then C, then H.
explain.trap: 'il veicolo H, il veicolo C, il veicolo L' is the reverse of the correct order L, C, H.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is L, C, H

keywords.it: il veicolo H, il veicolo C, il veicolo L
keywords.en: vehicle H, vehicle C, vehicle L

q23081.en: You may cross the junction in the picture in this order: vehicle H, vehicle L, vehicle C.

explain.short: H cannot go first: it has C on its right and L oncoming. H is last.
explain.rule: No signs here: give way to the right, and a car turning left lets oncoming straight traffic pass. Order: L, then C, then H.
explain.trap: 'il veicolo H' first is the trap: H goes last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is L, C, H

keywords.it: il veicolo H, il veicolo L, il veicolo C
keywords.en: vehicle H, vehicle L, vehicle C

q23082.en: You may cross the junction in the picture in this order: vehicle L, vehicle H, vehicle C.

explain.short: L first is right, but H cannot go before C: C is on H's right.
explain.rule: No signs here: give way to the right, and a car turning left lets oncoming straight traffic pass. Order: L, then C, then H.
explain.trap: 'il veicolo H, il veicolo C' is the trap: C goes before H.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: C goes before H

keywords.it: il veicolo L, il veicolo H, il veicolo C
keywords.en: vehicle L, vehicle H, vehicle C

q23083.en: You may cross the junction in the picture in this order: vehicle C, vehicle H, vehicle L.

explain.short: C cannot go first: L is on its right. L goes first, then C, then H.
explain.rule: No signs here: give way to the right, and a car turning left lets oncoming straight traffic pass. Order: L, then C, then H.
explain.trap: 'il veicolo C' first is the trap: L goes first.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is L, C, H

keywords.it: il veicolo C, il veicolo H, il veicolo L
keywords.en: vehicle C, vehicle H, vehicle L

q23089.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle B does not have to give way to any vehicle.

q23097.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture the vehicles go in this order: R, A, C.

explain.short: R has nobody on its right, A has R on its right, C has A on its right. So R, A, C.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'R, A, C' is exactly the correct order.

sceneParams.caption: Order: R, A, C

keywords.en: the vehicles go in the order

q23098.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle C does not have to give way to any vehicle.

explain.short: A comes from C's right, so C must give way. C goes last.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'non deve dare la precedenza ad alcun veicolo' is the trap: that is true for R, not for C.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: C gives way and goes last

keywords.en: does not have to give way

q23099.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle A goes before vehicle R and after vehicle C.

explain.short: It is the opposite: A goes after R (on its right) and before C.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'prima del veicolo R e dopo il veicolo C' is the trap: both parts are reversed.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: A goes after R, before C

q23100.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture the vehicles go in this order: R, C, A.

explain.short: C cannot go before A: A comes from C's right. The order is R, A, C.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'R, C, A' is the trap: C and A are swapped.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is R, A, C

keywords.en: the vehicles go in the order

q23101.en: By the right-of-way rules, at the junction shown in the picture vehicle R goes last.

explain.short: R has nobody on its right, so it goes first, not last.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then A, then C.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is the trap: R is first.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: R goes first

q23102.en: By the right-of-way rules, the junction shown in the picture may be entered by vehicle D after vehicle R has crossed.

explain.short: R comes from D's right, so D must let R pass first.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then D, then the truck B.
explain.trap: 'dopo l'attraversamento del veicolo R' (after R has crossed) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: R is on D's right: D waits

q23103.en: By the right-of-way rules, the junction shown in the picture may be entered by vehicle B after all the other vehicles have crossed.

explain.short: The truck B has D on its right, and D has R on its right. So B goes last.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then D, then the truck B.
explain.trap: 'dopo l'attraversamento di tutti gli altri veicoli' (after all the others) is correct for B.

sceneParams.caption: Order: R, D, B

q23104.en: By the right-of-way rules, the junction shown in the picture may be entered by vehicle R without giving way to any vehicle.

explain.short: No vehicle comes from R's right, so R gives way to nobody and goes first.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then D, then the truck B.
explain.trap: 'senza dare la precedenza ad alcun veicolo' (without giving way) is correct for R.

sceneParams.caption: R has a free right: it goes first

q23105.en: By the right-of-way rules, the junction shown in the picture may be entered by vehicle B after vehicles R and D have crossed.

explain.short: B waits for D (on its right), and D waits for R. So B goes after both.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then D, then the truck B.
explain.trap: 'dopo l'attraversamento dei veicoli R e D' (after R and D) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Order: R, D, B

q23106.en: By the right-of-way rules, the junction shown in the picture may be entered by vehicle B at the same time as vehicle R and before D.

explain.short: B has D on its right, so B cannot go before D, and not together with R either.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then D, then the truck B.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente al veicolo R e prima di quello D' is the trap: B goes last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: B goes last, after D

q23107.en: By the right-of-way rules, the junction shown in the picture may be entered by vehicle D before the other vehicles.

explain.short: R comes from D's right, so D must wait for R. D goes second.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then D, then the truck B.
explain.trap: 'prima degli altri veicoli' (before the others) is the trap: R goes first.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: D goes second, after R

q23108.en: By the right-of-way rules, the junction shown in the picture may be entered by vehicle R after vehicles B and D have crossed.

explain.short: It is the opposite: R has nobody on its right and goes first; B and D wait.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then D, then the truck B.
explain.trap: 'dopo l'attraversamento dei veicoli B e D' is the trap: R goes before them.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: R goes first

q23109.en: By the right-of-way rules, the junction shown in the picture may be entered by vehicle B before the other vehicles.

explain.short: The truck B has D on its right, so it must wait. B goes last, not first.
explain.rule: No signs here, so each driver gives way to the vehicle on their right. R has nobody on its right: R, then D, then the truck B.
explain.trap: 'prima degli altri veicoli' (before the others) is the trap: B is last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: B goes last
